13.t: Working with data: fluoride and teeth
q: Read the percentage with decay at 0.8 mg per litre.
More fluoride, less decay, but the effect levels off above about 1 mg per litre.
Suggest why many countries add fluoride at about 0.7-1.0 mg per litre, not 2.0.
Most of the benefit is gained by about 1 mg per litre; higher levels give little extra and can cause mottled teeth (fluorosis).
Suggest two other factors that should be the same in these towns for a fair comparison.
Diet (sugar intake), tooth brushing and fluoride toothpaste, access to dentists, family income.
